[[Jovial Pete]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for other [[item]]s of value. The Jovial Pete NPC is invisible, but shares a space with the [[Unsuccessful Novice|Corpse of Unsuccessful Novice]].

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Sepulchre of Dragrimmar}} (level 1, northeast of main entrance)

==Dialogue==
:''"*The corpse of Jovial Pete lies before you. His stiff fingers clutch a worn note that reads, "Hail, traveler! I'd get up and shake your hand, but I'm DEAD TIRED! Oh, I kill me. Actually, 'they' killed me, which brings me to my next point... I want them dead. That's right, destroyed, dismembered, decomposing, and discombobulated...DEAD! Kill those blasted dryders that did this to me. Bring me 5 [[Dryder Web]]s and you can have ONE item from my stash. I might be dead, but I swear I'll haunt you if you try to make off with more than what's owed, you measly [indecipherable]."*"''{{sic}}
